content: W3C vertical CJK conventions (w3c.github.io/i18n-drafts/articles/vertical-text): writing-mode vertical-rl for CJK - lines top-to-bottom, columns right-to-left. Han/Kana glyphs upright; embedded Latin and ASCII digits default to rotated (text-orientation mixed); fullwidth chars upright; tate-chu-yoko (text-combine-upright) lays 2-4 digit runs horizontally in the vertical flow; RTL script runs bottom-to-top. JLREQ-compatible punctuation compression (kumimoji) is deep typography beyond basic correctness. This is the D-11 correctness contract: upright CJK + rotated Latin/digits + RTL column flow.
